reviews.text: I want to warn others about my experience with McLeod Pools. I was charged $500 for a timer that didn’t need replacing, and the pool pump installed was lower HP than my previous pump, despite being told it would be comparable. Dylan has ignored my requests for any sort of resolution. I have contacted the BBB, and my next step would be small claims court. I stand behind the other negative remarks people have made against him.
reviews.author: Rana Stamm

reviews.text: Super impressed with this pool cleaning service! Dylan did an excellent job and made my pool look sparkly and inviting. Everything was handled quickly, professionally, and with great attention to detail. I’ll definitely be using this service again and highly recommend his services to anyone who wants their pool to look its best!
reviews.author: Meghan Goucher

reviews.text: Great pool company and Dylan is very good with communicating about any items he may see with our pool. Thank you McLeod Pools for keeping our pool crystal blue all summer long.
reviews.author: Uncle Bud

reviews.text: My family has used Dylan’s services for a few years now. He never disappoints. Our pool is immaculate
reviews.author: payton sullivan

reviews.text: Dylan really knows what he’s doing. Super easy to book, always shows up on time, and my pool has never looked better. You can tell he actually cares and takes the time to do it right. Whether it’s just regular cleaning or fixing stuff, he’s got it handled. If you’re thinking about hiring someone for your pool, this is your sign, go with McLeod Pools.
reviews.author: Sarah Shaikh

reviews.text: From start to finish, our experience with Dylan has been nothing short of exceptional. Their team was professional, knowledgeable, and incredibly easy to work with. They took the time to understand our vision and brought it to life with precision and creativity.
reviews.author: Chris Dillman

reviews.text: A buddy of mine recommended Dylan for maintenance to my pool, and I’m so glad I went with McLeod pools service. Dylan is great at what he does and got my pool ready for a special event in a timely manner. Will definitely be using McLeod’s pool services again😎
reviews.author: Alex Garcia

reviews.text: Very impressed with this company. Dylan is courteous and polite over the phone and in person. Strives to do what is best for your pool. I like that I get an update with photo of pool after each weekly visit. Never got that with previous company I used. I highly recommend McLeod Pools to anyone needing expert pool service.
reviews.author: Dan Hall

data.summary: The review profile is suspicious. The high Google rating is based on a small number of recent, generic 5-star reviews that conflict with the business's young age. A serious, detailed 1-star complaint alleges financial misconduct and ghosting, which aligns with the poor BBB rating. The positive reviews lack the specific detail and balanced feedback expected from real experiences.
fake_signals: Multiple 5-star reviews posted in same month (4 months ago) with similar generic praise
Reviews reference 'a few years' of service but business is only 1 year old per BBB
Lack of specific project details in positive reviews; heavy on generic adjectives
Low total review count (8) for a 4.7 rating, making score volatile

negative_evidence: Customer alleges being charged for unnecessary part and ignored when seeking resolution

authentic_signals: Negative review provides specific details (timer, pump HP, $500)
Varied reviewer names and some minor stylistic differences
One positive review mentions a specific feature (photo updates)
complaint_patterns: Threats of legal action from customer
data.discrepancy_explanation: High Google rating (4.7) contrasts sharply with a poor BBB rating (C-) and a serious recent complaint alleging overcharging and ignoring the customer. The BBB profile shows the business is only 1 year old, which is inconsistent with reviews referencing 'a few years' of service.
